sentences.japanese: はがきにこの切手を貼って郵便箱に投函しなさい。
sentences.english: Put this stamp on the postcard and drop it in the mailbox.

sentences.japanese: 封筒には切手を貼りましたか？
sentences.english: Did you put a stamp on the envelope?

sentences.japanese: その写真は至る所に貼ってある。
sentences.english: The pictures are pasted on all sides.

sentences.japanese: その写真はアルバムに貼ったほうがよい。
sentences.english: You should stick those pictures in your album.

sentences.japanese: この手紙に切手を貼って下さい。
sentences.english: Will you stamp this letter for me?
